reviews.title: Annoying
reviews.text: I really wanted to like this app, but it isn’t accurate. Example: If I import a recipe manually, of course I will have to use raw weights to measure out in order to cooked, but once it’s logged, I feel like the AI should change it to cooked. Instead im having to look up conversions from raw weight to cooked and edit it. I feel like I’m having to do a lot of outside work. I also feel like I have to do a lot of guessing work for my serving sizes. If I am putting in my goals, and my meal plan, I think the app should edit the meals so you know how much to measure out.

reviews.title: Greedy monetization & basic tracking flaws
reviews.text: Extremely disappointing. I bought a full annual plan expecting complete access to meal planning. Yet, despite paying a premium subscription, the app now demands extra "Coins" to generate meal plans. Why pay annually if features are locked behind microtransactions? Additionally, the body tracking is poorly designed: you can only enter one measurement for arms, forearms, thighs, and calves—as if we didn't have left and right sides! Greedy monetization and bad UX. 1 star
